page_title: LYO 1-2 TOU | Lyon v Toulouse 05/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' 1 - 2 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Emersonn (Toulouse) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight into the top right corner. He makes it 1:2.
90+6' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Toulouse.
90+4' The game is interrupted. Afonso Moreira (Lyon) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
90+2' Tyler Morton (Lyon) takes the corner but it's cleared.
90+2' The referee signals a substitution. Pavel Sulc (Lyon) is brought on as a substitute for Tanner Tessmann.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' 1 - 1 Here is an example of luck not being on your side. A slightly disorientated Clinton Mata (Lyon) puts the ball into his own net.
84' Tyler Morton (Lyon) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
83' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 6:4.
80' Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Thomas Leonard had an easy-decision to make.
78' The game has come to an end for Djibril Sidibe. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse).
78' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Cristian Casseres is replaced by Alexis Vossah (Toulouse).
78' Substitution. Adam Karabec is replaced by Afonso Moreira (Lyon).
76' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.
72' What a miss! The corner finds Emersonn (Toulouse) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the right post.
72' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is about to take a corner kick.
71' The manager makes a subsitution with Emersonn (Toulouse) coming on for Frank Magri.
71' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
69' Adam Karabec (Lyon) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
68' Tyler Morton (Lyon) launches a cross from the corner, but Guillaume Restes is alert to thwart the effort.
68' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lyon.
67' Malick Fofana (Lyon) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Lyon have a corner.
64' Adam Karabec (Lyon) is penalised for a foul. Thomas Leonard had a clear view and blows his whistle.
61' 70:30 – the ratio of ball possession.
59' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
57' Abu Francis (Toulouse) serves up a nice cross, but Dominik Greif punches the ball away.
55' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
53' A spell of possession for Lyon in an attempt to control the game.
51' Abu Francis (Toulouse) has tested the patience of referee Thomas Leonard and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
50' Toulouse concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player.
48' Toulouse are seeing far more of the ball now.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Mario Sauer (Toulouse) comes off for Abu Francis.
46' Half-time substitution. Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) is replaced by Dayann Methalie.
46' The whistle blows and Thomas Leonard starts the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' The corner from Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is intercepted by the defence.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' There's an opportunity for Mario Sauer (Toulouse) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
45' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Yann Gboho (Toulouse) inside the box. The ball goes out of play. Toulouse are awarded a corner kick.
42' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
39' Some patient build-up play from Toulouse as they look to unlock the defence.
37' The statistic for corner kicks – 2:1.
35' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

34' This was a piece of cake for Guillaume Restes. Malick Fofana (Lyon) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
33' Mario Sauer (Toulouse) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
32' Adam Karabec (Lyon) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
30' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Thomas Leonard saw the whole situation.
28' Total attempts – 5:2.
26' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
24' 1 - 0 Malick Fofana (Lyon) collects a delightful pass inside the box and nets with a perfect low drive into the middle of the goal. What a clinical finish!
23' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
21' Malick Fofana (Lyon) is caught offside!
20' Ball possession – 76:24.
19' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
17' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) picks up an injury.
16' Adam Karabec (Lyon) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
16' Lyon hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
14' The resulting corner from Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is cleared.

13' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and Toulouse manage to earn a corner.
11' A tremendous drive by Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Guillaume Restes makes a brilliant save.
10' What a big chance! Malick Fofana (Lyon) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
9' Adam Karabec (Lyon) sprays a pass out to Martin Satriano, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
7' The corner kick from Adam Karabec (Lyon) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
6' A pass lands at the feet of Malick Fofana (Lyon) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
6' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Dominik Greif comes off the line to clear the ball away.
5' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
3' Lyon keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Toulouse will have the kick-off.
Thomas Leonard will supervise the game today.
